checks.expected: The owner signs in through IAP; /v1/session reports cloud, iap-verified, recorded.
checks.observed: Owner signed in through IAP with the custom OAuth client (External, Testing, owner as sole test user); GET /v1/session returned 200 cloud/private-owner/recorded; the strip showed the private hosted label; no email, subject or token in the page.

checks.expected: A browser or client without an IAP session is redirected or denied before application state.
checks.observed: Anonymous requests: page 302 to Google sign-in, XHR API 401; before the OAuth client existed every request was refused with no application content; with IAP off the IAM-only service returned 403 to anonymous / and /health.

checks.expected: A forged or expired assertion receives authentication_required.
checks.observed: A client-supplied x-goog-iap-jwt-assertion was replaced by IAP (owner request still 200 with the real assertion; anonymous forged request 302 at IAP). Invalid-signature, expired, issuer, audience and algorithm cases are proved by the synthetic-key tests and the offline container probe; IAP secure_token_test mode returned IAP error 3 and was not used as evidence.

checks.expected: A signed-in, non-allowlisted Google account receives access_denied.
checks.reason: No second Google account is available; non-allowlisted denial is proved only by synthetic-key tests.

checks.expected: A browser Firestore REST call without credentials is denied by the deny-all rules.
checks.observed: Anonymous Firestore REST GET of leads returned 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; the active rules are allow read, write: if false.

checks.expected: The runtime identity reads and writes schema-valid documents in the Toronto database.
checks.observed: The runtime identity (datastore.user only) recorded the hosted system bundle at startup and stored and read lead, run, events, evidence and draft documents; metrics counted the stored lead.

checks.expected: Intake answers 202 and the run stays persisted until the execution request.
checks.observed: Intake answered 202; stored events begin lead.persisted then run.claimed, the claim coming from the separate execution request.

checks.expected: The held execution request completes while polling shows stored progress.
checks.observed: The held execution request completed the run (status complete, 21 events) in about 3 s, inside the 45 s budget, while the dossier polled stored state.

checks.expected: A duplicate execution request is a conflict and repeats no effect.
checks.observed: Re-sending execute with the original revision returned 409 revision_conflict; executing the completed run returned 409 run_ineligible; no effect repeated.

checks.expected: An interrupted run resumes after its lease expires; stale revisions conflict.
checks.reason: No hosted run was interrupted; deadline, lease reclaim and resume are proved on the emulator (p3-hosted-execution-emulator).

checks.expected: Every enrichment record is labelled recorded; no live lookup occurs.
checks.observed: Both lookups for the 2020 Subaru Outback / 22150 lead were found and labelled recorded; the run enrichmentMode is recorded.

checks.expected: Drafts stay consent-gated, human-reviewed and unsent.
checks.observed: The consented lead produced a draft in pending_review after 8 of 8 rules; nothing was sent and no send route exists.

checks.expected: Logs carry status, latency and revision only; no contact value, assertion, subject, cookie or IAM list.
checks.observed: 18 request and 4 system log entries contained no email, subject, token or contact value; the application writes no logs. Cloud Audit activity and system-event entries record the deployer and the service configuration, including the allowlist variable, by platform design and stay inside the project.

checks.expected: The revision matches the template: digest, limits, identity, region, Iap Enabled true.
checks.observed: Revision leadflow-ai-demo-95b6c04eda59 runs the built digest with 1 vCPU, 512 MiB, concurrency 8, 60 s timeout, runtime identity leadflow-ai-runtime, Toronto region and IAP enabled.

checks.expected: The invoker policy holds only the IAP service agent; no allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
checks.observed: The service invoker policy holds only the IAP service agent with roles/run.invoker; project IAM lists only the owner and the two service identities.

checks.expected: Cloud Run and project spend are recorded, or pending with a reason; never zero by default.
checks.observed: Usage posted at CA$0.00 (free tiers): Cloud Run 32 requests, 25.1 s CPU, 12.55 GiB-s memory; Cloud Build 4.9 min; Firestore Toronto 551 reads, 321 writes. Month to date and forecast CA$0.00; Cloud Run cap ~$0.00 of $10; project alert budget $0.00 of $10. Read-only in the console; an interim 09:45 reading also showed CA$0.00.

checks.expected: Traffic returns to the verified previous revision and smoke 1, 2, 5 and 6 pass there.
checks.observed: Revision leadflow-ai-demo-d6ded3f29172 (build ca7688ad-e0eb-44ed-932c-ec86e0f53c71) deployed at 0% with the candidate tag, then served 100% and passed session, intake, held execution and recorded-label smoke. Traffic returned to leadflow-ai-demo-95b6c04eda59 with IAP on; anonymous page and API requests were refused (302, 401); owner session, intake 202, held execution to complete, lead.persisted first, recorded labels and the no-consent draft skip passed under the candidate bundle.

checks.expected: The seven-day and 30-day removals run against reverified exact resources.
checks.reason: Scheduled, not yet due: the service, synthetic data, service-specific access and non-final images are removed within seven days of the owner approving the evidence and walkthrough, and the final image and repository by day 30.
